top_signals.title: China Banks Use Overnight Rate for Bonds as PBOC Reform Widens
top_signals.summary: Chinese lenders have started pricing bonds off the nation’s overnight funding cost, an indication that it’s increasingly the benchmark for the financial system.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.
